payload.title: Umbrella: ace as universal ZetaId pointer resolver — eight target kinds, resolver/supervisor line at first-transition-plus-declared-invariant, ContentAddress realization key as the idempotency key. Structural finding: src/Core.TypeScript/ace (bytes, trust, capability) and src/Core.TypeScript/service (launchd/systemd/task-scheduler adapters) are the two halves of this resolver and currently do not reference each other.
